summary: Real Messenger Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing proxy materials for a class meeting of Class A shareholders and an annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for May 5, 2026. The class meeting proposes a special resolution to increase voting rights per Class B share from 10 to 25 votes, subject to class consent. The AGM includes ordinary resolutions to re-elect directors, ratify Marcum Asia CPAs LLP as auditor, and a special resolution to adopt amended articles reflecting the voting rights change. There is no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event; this is a routine governance and meeting disclosure.
